### Vocabulary in scope

New at this step:
- scale type (also: ScaleType) — it is necessary that each kind of property is measured on exactly one scale type (HCP L5 — KindOfProperty (id, scale))
- ratio scale — it is necessary that each ratio scale permits at least 1 quotient law (HCP L5 — ScaleType.ratio: the scale type that licenses × and ÷)
- quotient law (also: KindDiv) — it is necessary that each quotient law is permitted by exactly one ratio scale (HCP L5 — KindDiv, QuotientKind.ofRatio: a curated quotient law, δ = γ/(2m))
- gated sum — it is necessary that each gated sum adds at least 1 quantity (HCP L5 — Quantity.add: kind- and scale-gated addition)
- bearer erasure — it is necessary that each bearer erasure forgets exactly one individual quantity (HCP L5 — IndividualQuantity.toQuantity: forget the bearer)
- damper — it is necessary that each damper is a component of exactly one whole (HCP L5 — Losing energy: add a damper)
- damping coefficient (also: dampingCoefficient) — the quantity kind `damping coefficient` (ratio scale), adopted from PhysLibKinds
- viscous damping constant (also: viscousDampingConstantK) — the quantity kind `viscous damping constant` (ratio scale), adopted from PhysLibKinds
- KindOfProperty — another name for *kind of property*, carried from PKC
- angularFrequencyK — another name for *angular frequency*, carried from L0
- *kind of property* is measured on *scale type* — verb
- *ratio scale* permits *quotient law* — verb
- *quotient law* is permitted by *ratio scale* — verb
- *gated sum* adds *quantity* — verb
- *bearer erasure* forgets *individual quantity* — verb
